ownership: Existing: accepted .wflow/compiler, durable runtime, gateway/independent MCP providers, EngineeringResult/provenance, revision-bound validator/rework, typed inputs/review, instruction snapshots and common workspace.
integration: Bind this plan to supported existing contracts; add no replacement executor or UI.
qualification_evidence: Compiler and runtime results for the actual binding, with revision/provenance assertions.
dependent_steps: M0 and all runtime milestones; hold unsupported bindings.

ownership: Proposed engineering-specific bindings on existing provenance, input and validation facilities.
integration: Implement or resolve lineage/source grouping, observability mapping, uncertainty inputs, immutable manifest checks and invalidation dependencies.
qualification_evidence: Executed AC-03 through AC-07 plus revision and rights/access checks.
dependent_steps: M2 onward; missing choices are input_required, missing executable checks are capability_unavailable.

capability: Per-request model guard and observable capture
ownership: Existing gateway/MCP invocation, redaction and provenance own the execution path; the required engineering guard must be integrated there if absent.
integration: Reject drift before every observed request; bind gpt-6-astra/high, source instruction snapshot and exact accessible artifact hashes; preserve actual observable request records without claiming provider-internal visibility.
qualification_evidence: AC-08 on each relevant actual path, including helper/recovery paths. Unknown support or inaccessible enforcement is a hold, not fallback permission.
dependent_steps: All model-dependent production, measurement, correction and recovery.

ownership: Proposed test bindings using pre-existing geometry and existing requirements.
integration: Connect qualified readers, projection/dimension checks and negative controls to existing validators. Do not treat fixture metadata or an unexecuted schema as a runtime implementation.
qualification_evidence: Executed AC-01 through AC-05 with repeatability records.
dependent_steps: M1; scope limited to synthetic checks, not real-photo accuracy or live providers.

capability: Editable CAD producer and exact export reader
ownership: Qualified gateway/MCP tools or other already-supported Wright integrations; no vendor workaround.
integration: Resolve an actual producer for required native editability and export formats, plus an independent qualified reader for exact exports. Capture operation identities, versions and hashes.
qualification_evidence: Native parameter/feature editability, topology/intent and format/unit/frame preservation tests on declared cases; producer and reader results with provenance.
dependent_steps: M4-M6; unavailable required tooling yields capability_unavailable.

capability: Geometry measurements and conditional reconstruction methods
ownership: Proposed method-specific integrations into existing measurement/result/validator facilities.
integration: Qualify projection, silhouettes/landmarks, dimensions/sections and bidirectional surfaces separately. Enable visual hull or SfM/MVS only when their assumptions and required tools are satisfied; label learned output as hypothesis.
qualification_evidence: Synthetic tests followed, when authorized evidence exists, by representative independently referenced real-observation validation with declared uncertainty and coverage. Fixtures alone are insufficient.
dependent_steps: M3, M5 and M7; disable optional unsupported methods and hold required dependent checks.

ownership: Existing revision-bound rework/runtime owns scheduling; proposed engineering guards own allowlists, budgets, objective checks and holdout isolation.
integration: Bind supplied limits and stop rules, mutation reconciliation, dependency invalidation and separate audit evidence to supported Wright facilities.
qualification_evidence: Executed AC-09 through AC-12; actual independent verifier and source-group checks for project audit.
dependent_steps: M6-M7; missing limits are input_required and missing guards/verifier are capability_unavailable.

ownership: Separate qualified integrations and supplied engineering requirements, not implied by reconstruction.
integration: Enable only explicitly requested nonphysical checks with authorized rules and tools. Unsupported functional or manufacturing requirements remain unverified; do not invent process constants or authorize physical tests.
qualification_evidence: Requirement-specific executed tests; later sheet-metal drawing/section evidence retains its original scope.
dependent_steps: Only applicable checks and claims; no production release or automatic acceptance.

capability: Storage bounds, portable handoff and declared review
ownership: Existing workspace, snapshots, runtime and review facilities, with run-specific binding/enforcement to verify.
integration: Bind storage/retention limits and cleanup permissions; export authorized portable references and snapshots without credentials or environment guarantees; route exact-revision reports to declared review.
qualification_evidence: Executed AC-12 through AC-14 and an actual review record only if later provided through Wright.
dependent_steps: All retention-sensitive steps and M8; missing required configuration is input_required, unavailable enforcement is capability_unavailable.
